Toxic FistBasic
Deals 180% DEF DMG to a single enemy, with a 60% chance to inflict 1 layer of [Poison] for 2 turns.
OverwhelmingActiveExclusive Lv.1
Deals 380% DEF DMG to a single enemy, with a 80% chance to inflict [Silence] for 1 turn. Increases the chance by 20% if the target's DEF is less than self's.
Heart of Forest Lv.1When Stan releases Overwhelming, his DEF is increased by 30% for 2 turns.
Moss-covered SkinPassiveExclusive Lv.2
The [Poison] DMG inflicted by Stan is calculated based on his DEF. Each layer of [Poison] deals 100% DEF DMG. Increases Stan's DEF by 6% when he takes Direct DMG (up to 10 times). This effect cannot be removed.
Heart of Forest Lv.2[Poison] DMG dealt by Stan is increased by 15%.
Rolling StonesActiveExclusive Lv.3
Deals 100% DEF DMG to a single enemy, with a 90% chance to inflict 5 layers of [Poison] for 2 turns.
Heart of Forest Lv.3When Rolling Stones is released, there is a 100% chance to inflict [Silence] for 1 turn if the target's DEF is less than his own.
